research_problem: No automated testing approach or tool exists for modern RPC-based APIs (Thrift, gRPC, Dubbo, SOFARPC) widely used in industrial microservices
technical_approach: Framework-agnostic RPC schema extracted via Java reflection from RPC interfaces (with javax/Thrift constraints); tests as sequences of RPC calls evolved by MIO in EvoMaster with white-box heuristics, SQL handling and new RPC-specific testing targets (handled/error, success/fail, null/empty)
primary_contribution: First white-box search-based fuzzer for RPC APIs, integrated into Meituan's CI
dataset_benchmark: 2 artificial Thrift APIs + 4 Meituan industrial APIs (195K LoC) in depth; 50 further Meituan APIs (1.44M LoC), 54 industrial in total
evaluation_metrics: Line and target coverage, unique potential faults, manually triaged real faults; Mann-Whitney U, Vargha-Delaney A12 over 30 runs
baselines: Random search (grey-box) within EvoMaster; Meituan's existing manual/replay tests
key_findings: Significantly better than random on all 6 SUTs (A12>0.80; up to +47% artificial, +11.15% industrial); industrial line coverage 9-27%, avg 17.49% on 50 APIs; exceeds existing tests; 126 real faults (24 L1, 17 L2, 85 L3), 41 fixed; 8,377 potential faults pending; low coverage due to external services, business-level validation, huge DTOs, DB state
author_limitations: Single fixed budget; one company and Thrift-based framework; industrial results not replicable; gRPC result analysis incomplete; only MIO; external services, DB reset, flakiness, readability open
analyst_limitations: Weak baseline (own random search); self-evaluation by tool authors; exception-only oracle misses semantic bugs; empty databases; no gRPC/GraphQL evaluation despite 'modern RPC' framing; potential-fault inflation
reproducibility: EvoMaster open-source and artificial SUTs public; industrial data confidential; 129 days compute
suggested_extensions: Open-source RPC/gRPC benchmark; search-integrated external service mocking; LLM-generated complex DTO inputs; production data seeding; semantic oracles and automated fault triage; non-JVM/gRPC support
evidence_location: Approach p.9-20; Table 2 p.21; RQ1 p.23; RQ2 p.24-27; Table 6-7 p.28-29; lessons p.30-32; threats p.32
integrity: Fig.6 UML glyph-garbled; code listings letter-spaced; Tables 3,5,6 column-split; key numbers cross-checked with text
